name: Espírito Santo
range: Northern Espírito Santo, from Itaúnas (18°25′S); summer distribution between Conceição da Barra and Santa Cruz
note: Northernmost, demographically isolated population; part of the subspecies P. b. pukusi. High-density area near the Doce River mouth.
src: Sucunza et al. (2023); CMS COP15 Doc.31.3.7

name: Northern Rio de Janeiro
note: Separated from FMA Ia by a distribution gap; genetically distinct (Cunha et al. 2014).
src: Di Beneditto & Ramos; Cunha et al. (2014)

name: Rio de Janeiro (south) and northern São Paulo
range: Northern limit at Ilha Grande Bay, possibly Jaconé (22°56′S); northern São Paulo coast
note: Strandings recorded within the former gap between Macaé and Ilha Grande (Azevedo et al. 2026).
src: Azevedo et al. (2026); Ballabio et al. (2025)

name: Southern São Paulo, Paraná and Santa Catarina
range: Southern São Paulo to Santa Catarina (limits as in Cunha et al. 2020)
note: Includes the Paraná coast. Limits between IIa and IIb follow Cunha et al. (2014, 2020).

name: Babitonga Bay
note: The only population resident year-round in an estuary; recognised as a distinct management unit.

name: Rio Grande do Sul and Uruguay
range: Rio Grande do Sul (Brazil) and Uruguay, including the Río de la Plata estuary
note: Highest bycatch levels recorded; population structure within the Río de la Plata to be redefined (RES-1.1).
src: Secchi et al. (2003); CMS Concerted Action 14.5 (2024)

name: Argentina, FMA IVa
range: Argentina (limits as in Cunha et al. 2020)
note: No abundance survey reported; Samborombón Bay not yet flown (CMS COP15 Doc.31.3.7).
src: Cunha et al. (2020); CMS COP15 Doc.31.2.8

name: Argentina, FMA IVb
range: Buenos Aires Province (limits as in Cunha et al. 2020)
note: Surveyed from the air in 2019–2022 (Crespo et al. 2026).

name: Argentina, FMA IVc
range: Buenos Aires Province (limits as in Cunha et al. 2020)
note: Surveyed from the air in 2019–2022 (Crespo et al. 2026).

name: Argentina, FMA IVd
range: Southern Buenos Aires (limits as in Cunha et al. 2020)
note: Area from Claromecó to Bahía Blanca not yet surveyed (CMS COP15 Doc.31.3.7).

name: Argentina, FMA IVe
range: Southern limit at the north coast of San Matías Gulf (42°10′S), including the Río Negro estuary
note: Río Negro estuary proposed as a conservation area (MIT 2.1).
